comparison.objective: Separate media from retained washers, versus install safety caps on rebar stubs.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent sifting versus repeated axial alignment and interference-fit insertion.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% media recovered with no washer loss, versus five caps seated to depth/alignment thresholds and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Aperture-mediated bulk separation is meaningfully different from discrete press-fit installation.
